subject: Kickoff: fast gradient clipping for DP-SGD
body:
Team — kicking off the fast gradient clipping adoption track.

Context: DP-SGD's per-example gradient clipping is the tax every privacy-sensitive training job pays, and our open-source release of the unified fast gradient clipping framework shows how to cut it substantially. Goal for the window: land the framework in the internal DP training stack and publish before/after cost numbers privacy teams can budget against.

Milestones: repro the paper's runtime-profiling experiments (fully connected, embedding, and BERT targets) by May 1; integration behind a flag by May 29; adoption guide plus a cost memo to the privacy council by Jun 19, ahead of the Q3 OKR lock on Jun 26.

Leilani owns integration, Bilal profiling, Csilla the correctness review, Vera the BERT-scale runs. Bruno follows up on staffing.

Zofia
